condition_rule: Inherit common_conditions and add claim conditions.

conditions: MCX user initiates Emergency Alert capability
claims.conclusion: User enters Emergency State; that UE sends alert. Automatic Emergency Group Communication is administrator-configurable.

conditions: That state not cancelled on UE
claims.conclusion: UE retains state; user's group/private communication transmissions are corresponding emergency communications.

conditions: Local UE-state cancellation or service alert cancellation, respectively
claims.conclusion: Local control only for authorized user of that UE; support alert cancellation by authorized MCX users and distribute cancellation to affiliated members of identified group.

limitations: No group In-progress Emergency state machine, remote cancellation protocol or authentication implementation.
